description.text: Grants [Attach Wind with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Nine], [Apex High Jump Damage Tracker] and [Apex High Jump Level]

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Nine
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex High Jump (0~2), removed after using Apex High Jump two times

description.name: Apex High Jump Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex High Jump level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Nine]

description.name: Apex High Jump Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex High Jump level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Nine]
